key.name: enable-gaps
key.description: Toggle gaps on or off globally.

key.name: show-advanced-json
key.description: Persist visibility of the advanced JSON editor tab.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Enable verbose debug logging in system logs.

key.name: self-maximize-mode
key.description: Which apps may maximize or fullscreen their tiled windows themselves (title bar, F11, starting maximized). 'never', 'allow-listed' (only apps in self-maximize-allow-list) or 'all-except-listed' (all apps except those in self-maximize-block-list).

key.name: self-maximize-allow-list
key.description: App ids or WM classes, without .desktop. An entry also covers ids continuing it after '.' or '-'.

key.name: self-maximize-block-list
key.summary: Apps Not Allowed to Maximize Themselves
key.description: App ids or WM classes, without .desktop. An entry also covers ids continuing it after '.' or '-'.

key.name: maximize-focus-policy
key.summary: Maximized Window When Another Comes Forward
key.description: What happens to a maximized or fullscreen tiled window when another window of its layout gains focus or opens: 'keep', 'unmaximize' or 'pass-on' (the other window takes the maximization over).

key.name: hide-maximize-button
key.description: Removes the maximize button from window title bars of all apps while the extension is enabled.

key.name: saved-button-layout
key.description: Internal: the original org.gnome.desktop.wm.preferences button-layout while the maximize button is hidden.

key.name: keybindings-mode
key.description: Use 'default' for rigid Super+Arrows, or 'custom' for custom bindings.

key.name: inner-gaps
key.description: Gap size between tiled windows.

key.name: outer-gaps
key.description: Gap size between windows and screen edges.

key.name: move-window-left
key.description: Swap active window with the one to its left.

key.name: move-window-right
key.description: Swap active window with the one to its right.

key.name: move-window-up
key.description: Swap active window with the one above it.

key.name: move-window-down
key.description: Swap active window with the one below it.

key.name: custom-move-window-left
key.description: Custom swap active window with the one to its left.

key.name: custom-move-window-right
key.description: Custom swap active window with the one to its right.

key.name: custom-move-window-up
key.description: Custom swap active window with the one above it.

key.name: custom-move-window-down
key.description: Custom swap active window with the one below it.

key.name: focus-window-mode
key.description: Mode for focus window keybindings (default or custom).

key.name: focus-window-left
key.description: Focus window to the left.

key.name: focus-window-right
key.description: Focus window to the right.

key.name: focus-window-up
key.description: Focus window above.

key.name: focus-window-down
key.description: Focus window below.

key.name: custom-focus-window-left
key.description: Custom focus window to the left.

key.name: custom-focus-window-right
key.description: Custom focus window to the right.

key.name: custom-focus-window-up
key.description: Custom focus window above.

key.name: custom-focus-window-down
key.description: Custom focus window below.

key.name: shortcut-close-monitor
key.description: Close all windows on the active monitor.

key.name: close-monitor-include-minimized
key.description: Also close minimized windows on the monitor.

key.name: shortcut-close-workspace
key.description: Close all windows on the current workspace.

key.name: shortcut-switch-monitor
key.description: Swap monitors content or swap active with primary.

key.name: shortcut-unminimize-workspace
key.description: Unminimize all windows on the active workspace.

key.name: custom-layouts
key.description: JSON string defining custom window layouts.

key.name: shadowed-keybindings
key.description: Internal state tracking GNOME native keybindings that have been temporarily removed to prevent conflicts with custom shortcuts.
